description: Reserved  -  Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Impose a Special Commodity Levy on   B'onions
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing a levy on specific commodities. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements related to taxation and commodity regulation, rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
